parameters.description:
`msg-to-zoom` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Zoom destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional Zoom destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Zoom destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to Zoom Chat incoming webhook
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Zoom destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Zoom token

webhook_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Zoom webhook id
